description: A real technical decision with its reason, stated by the user after a failure.

events.text: CI fails with 'database is locked' when several chloe processes open a new database at once.
cargo test concurrency: 12 processes call SqliteStore::open on a missing file; 3 fail with SQLITE_BUSY during schema creation.
Decision: retry init() for up to 5 seconds instead of adding a daemon. A daemon is out of scope for milestone B0 because every hook would then depend on a running process.
Edited crates/memory-store/src/lib.rs: init() now retries on SQLITE_BUSY for 5s.

candidates.title: Retry store init for 5 s instead of adding a daemon
candidates.content: Concurrent first opens of a new database fail with SQLITE_BUSY. init() retries for up to 5 seconds. A daemon is deliberately not added in milestone B0 because every hook would then depend on a running process.

candidates.title: Concurrent first open of a new SQLite file fails with SQLITE_BUSY
candidates.content: Several processes creating the schema at once get 'database is locked'.
